pages.title: Bhubaneswar: places, food & living culture · Utkal Project
pages.description: Begin in Bhubaneswar: follow stories in stone, choose a few places to linger and connect the city with Dhauli and the Odisha coast.

pages.title: Dhauli · Utkal Project
pages.description: Look closely at Dhauli’s layered landscape of remembrance and belief. Plan a thoughtful visit and continue towards Konark.
pages.social_alt: The white Shanti Stupa above a flight of steps at Dhauli.

pages.title: Konark Sun Temple · Utkal Project
pages.description: Explore Konark through its Sun Temple, carved details, coastal connections and food. Gather ideas for your own Odisha journey.
pages.social_alt: A richly carved stone chariot wheel and relief-covered wall at Konark Sun Temple, with protective metal railings in front.

pages.title: Puri: places, food & living culture · Utkal Project
pages.description: Discover Puri through the shore, its living sacred traditions and food. Leave space for local rhythms and a visit to Raghurajpur.
pages.social_alt: People walking on wet sand beside the sea at Puri beach.

pages.title: Raghurajpur · Utkal Project
pages.description: Meet Raghurajpur through its craft tradition and village setting. Approach a visit with curiosity, respect and time to look closely.
pages.social_alt: An artisan holding a work of art in the doorway of a painted house in Raghurajpur.

pages.title: A table by the coast · Utkal Project
pages.description: A coastal table: explore Mahaprasad, fish, prawns and chhena poda with context and questions to ask before choosing your meal.
pages.social_alt: Two golden pieces of chhena poda on a dark plate, with fruit and a garnish.

pages.title: Chilika · Utkal Project
pages.description: A beginning for understanding the coast through water, wildlife and local knowledge.
pages.social_alt: A blue passenger boat crosses grey water, with birds flying above and the distant shore on the horizon.

pages.title: Mangalajodi · Utkal Project
pages.description: Begin with the birds. Stay for the people who know their names.
pages.social_alt: A dense flock of birds in flight above the Mangalajodi wetland.

pages.title: Kalijai · Utkal Project
pages.description: A crossing on the lagoon, a shrine on the island, a name held in memory.
pages.social_alt: The blue Kalijai temple beside a palm tree, with its courtyard in the foreground.

pages.title: Satapada · Utkal Project
pages.description: Choose a day on the water, with room for the unexpected.
pages.social_alt: A blue passenger boat crosses grey water, with birds flying above and the distant shore on the horizon.

pages.title: Watch the wetlands at Mangalajodi · Utkal Project
pages.description: Make birds the centre of the visit. A local birding guide can help you notice what would otherwise pass as a distant shape on the water. Winter is the season to plan around for migratory birds.
pages.social_alt: A narrow covered boat with people aboard on a still channel between green wetland vegetation.

pages.title: Take the boat to Kalijai · Utkal Project
pages.description: Combine a lagoon crossing with a visit to the island shrine. Barkul is a starting point to investigate; agree on the route before leaving the shore.
pages.social_alt: The blue Kalijai temple beside a palm tree, with its courtyard in the foreground.

pages.title: Look for dolphins from Satapada · Utkal Project
pages.description: Satapada is known for boat trips associated with Chilika’s Irrawaddy dolphins. Go for the lagoon as well as its wildlife: a sighting is never guaranteed.
pages.social_alt: A blue passenger boat crosses grey water, with birds flying above and the distant shore on the horizon.

pages.title: Staying in Mangalajodi · Utkal Project
pages.description: Consider this base when birdwatching is the main reason for your visit. Odisha Tourism lists a nature camp here.
pages.social_alt: A dense flock of birds in flight above the Mangalajodi wetland.

pages.title: Staying in Barkul or Rambha · Utkal Project
pages.description: Two lakeside bases to research. Odisha Tourism lists Panthanivas accommodation at both; Barkul also appears in its Kalijai excursion listing.
pages.social_alt: A blue passenger boat crosses grey water, with birds flying above and the distant shore on the horizon.

pages.title: Staying around Rajhans and Satapada · Utkal Project
pages.description: Investigate Rajhans Nature Camp for this side of the lagoon. Confirm the arrival point and onward boat transfer with the property before choosing it.
pages.social_alt: A blue passenger boat crosses grey water, with birds flying above and the distant shore on the horizon.

pages.title: Mukteswar · Utkal Project
pages.description: Pause at Mukteswar’s carved gateway in Bhubaneswar. Explore the temple through photographs, architectural details and practical questions for your visit.
pages.social_alt: A carved stone arch at Mukteswar, with the temple behind it and a visitor passing beneath.

pages.title: A meal in Bhubaneswar · Utkal Project
pages.description: Make room for dalma, pakhala and chhena poda in Bhubaneswar. Discover the dishes, ask about their preparation and save a meal idea for your journey.
pages.social_alt: Two golden pieces of chhena poda on a dark plate, with fruit and a garnish.

pages.title: Find your city base · Utkal Project
pages.description: Compare Old Town, central Bhubaneswar and arrival-focused accommodation areas. Ask about transport, facilities and the exact address before booking.
pages.social_alt: Carved stone temple towers at Mukteswar, Bhubaneswar, against a blue sky.

pages.title: Bhubaneswar’s Painted Streets | Utkal Project
pages.description: Walk through Bhubaneswar’s painted streets in February 2009. Photographs by Ahimanikya Satapathy, with cultural connections, sources and a preserved archive.
pages.social_alt: A procession painted on a red Bhubaneswar wall, photographed in February 2009.

pages.title: Barabati Fort · Utkal Project

pages.title: Tarakasi · follow a silver thread · Utkal Project
pages.description: Look past the shine. Find the hand, the fine line and the time inside the work.
pages.social_alt: A pendant and earrings with intricate looping filigree patterns.

pages.title: Dahibara Aloodum in Cuttack · Utkal Project
pages.description: One bowl, several textures. Leave a pause in the day for a conversation over food.
pages.social_alt: Dahibara and aloodum served together in a leaf bowl in Cuttack.

pages.title: Netaji Birthplace Museum · Utkal Project
pages.description: Before the world knew Netaji, Cuttack knew a child named Subhas. Begin with the city that helped shape him.

pages.title: Choose a Cuttack base · Utkal Project
pages.description: Choose the return journey before you choose the view. A good base gives the day room to breathe.
pages.social_alt: The surviving stone gateway at Barabati Fort in Cuttack.

pages.title: Languages of Odisha · Utkal Project

pages.description: A language can be a page, a poem, a conversation—or the familiar sound that makes a distant place feel like home.

pages.title: Odia Literature · Utkal Project
pages.description: Meet the writers. Step into a story. Discover how a page can open onto an entire place.
pages.social_alt: An Odia palm-leaf manuscript beside a metal writing stylus.

pages.title: Fakir Mohan Senapati · Utkal Project
pages.description: Start with the everyday. Look again. A life that seems ordinary may hold a story about an entire society.
pages.social_alt: A garlanded commemorative bust of Fakir Mohan Senapati.

pages.title: Six Acres and a Third · Utkal Project
pages.description: A small piece of land can reveal a very large world.
pages.social_alt: A garlanded commemorative bust of Fakir Mohan Senapati.

pages.title: Sarala Das · Utkal Project

pages.title: Gangadhar Meher · Utkal Project
